messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High 5xx rate detected for rtr-gateway (eu-west-1). 5xx rate ~12% over 5m, customer-facing errors increasing. SLO at risk. Incident record: https://redwood.app/incident/INC-2024-045. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/gateway-5xx

alice: I'm oncall — starting triage. Looks like a deploy ~10m ago to rtr-gateway. Rolling back to last stable now.

alice: kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/rtr-gateway --to-revision=56  # rolling back to v2.14.1

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by alice. Rollout ID: rtr-rollout-2024-2249. Notifying k8s watchers.

ben: seeing an uptick of upstream 502s to model-edge-primary in the same window. Logs show repeated 502/504 from that upstream (connection reset).

carla: Prometheus check (5m window):
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"rtr-gateway\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"rtr-gateway\"}[5m])) * 100
```
Result: ~11.8% -> trending down after rollback started.

carla: Recommend muting the noisy paging alert for 30m while we stabilise to avoid alert fatigue. /alert mute alert-gtw-5xx 30m

alice: +1 mute for 30m. Mute applied. (will annotate incident)

ben: Infra: model-edge-primary shows intermittent TLS handshake errors to our egress nodes. Reached out to provider on support channel. Meanwhile flipping traffic to model-edge-secondary via HAProxy.

ben: HAProxy temporary rule (applied):
```
backend model-edge
  balance leastconn
  server primary 10.4.1.23:443 check fall 3 rise 2 backup
  server secondary 10.4.2.11:443 check rise 2
```
This treats primary as backup for now.

alice: Rollback finished — gateway rolled back to v2.14.1. 5xx rate now down to 1.2% overall, upstream-502s ~0.8% on secondary. Customers reporting fewer failures.

alice: We should adjust alerting to reduce noise but still catch regressions. Proposal: change alert-gtw-5xx from "page if 5% over 5m" to "warning at 3% over 10m (no page), page at 7% sustained over 5m". Also add an upstream-specific rule for upstream_502_rate > 2% to create a non-noisy paging rule tied to provider issues. Thoughts?

carla: +1 on two-tier alert. Also add a dashboard panel breaking down 5xx by upstream (model-edge-primary, secondary, internal). I'll spin up a Grafana panel and link it in the runbook.

ben: Agree. Also add a short suppression window for deploys: if deploy event tag present, suppress pages for 10m with an automatic heartbeat check so we don't completely blind ourselves. Runbook needs that step.

alice: Noted actions for post-incident:
- Update runbook with rollback steps + HAProxy circuit-break example (alice)
- Create Grafana panel for per-upstream 5xx (carla)
- Alert tuning: implement two-step alert + upstream-specific alert (ben)
- Add deploy suppress logic to paging rule (alice + eng-sre)

pagerduty: On-call handoff scheduled: alice -> dan at 23:00 UTC. Dan will take over after handoff message.

dan: Ack, I'll take watch. Please add me to follow-ups and the incident ticket.

alice: Handoff summary for dan: root cause likely an intermittent failure at model-edge-primary combined with a recent gateway deploy — deploy increased request fanout and exposed upstream instability. Immediate mitigations: rollback gateway, circuit-break primary to backup, mute pages briefly. Postmortem items created.

carla: Created ticket INC-2024-045-FOLLOW with links: https://redwood.app/tickets/INC-2024-045-FOLLOW. ETA dashboard: next Wed. ETA alert changes: EOD today for fire-and-forget change, full test & rollout next week.

alice: Proposed alert text for update (for review):
"Gateway 5xx rate (rtr-gateway) - WARNING: 3% 5xx sustained over 10m (no page). CRITICAL: 7% 5xx sustained over 5m -> page eng-oncall. Exception: suppress pages during deploy tag for 10m, but keep CRITICAL if downstream upstream_502_rate > 2%."

ben: Looks good. Add a PromQL for the upstream-specific alert: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"rtr-gateway\", upstream=~\"model-edge.*\", status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (upstream) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"rtr-gateway\", upstream=~\"model-edge.*\"}[5m])) by (upstream) * 100 > 2`

alice: Leaving a final short summary for the postmortem: rollback + HAProxy circuit-break to secondary restored acceptable error rates. Root cause likely provider instability; follow-ups to improve alert granularity and automated deploy suppression. Assign owners. :thumbsup:

carla: Adding one more follow-up — run a chaos test that simulates upstream 502s and confirm alert behaviour / suppression works as intended. Assigning to eng-ml & eng-sre.

alice: Thanks team. I'll handoff to dan in 5. If anything spikes, page as usual.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2024-045 status updated: mitigated -> stable. All active pages suppressed. Postmortem ticket created.

dan: Thanks — acked and monitoring.
